input: Our thermal management suddenly stops throttling and the SoC hits critical shutdown at 115C. dmesg shows repeated: 'tsens: sensor 3 read timeout, last valid temp 72000 mC'. The TSENS ADC conversion register (TSENS_Sn_STATUS offset 0x44) reads 0xFFFFFFFF which means the sensor is not responding. After this, the thermal zone enters polling mode but get_temp() returns the stale 72C value indefinitely — the governor thinks everything is fine. The TSENS block sits on an APB bus clocked by a peripheral clock that we suspect gets gated during a clock optimization pass. How do we verify the TSENS peripheral clock state, and is there a kernel mechanism to mark a thermal zone as invalid when sensor reads fail so the governor takes a safe fallback action?
